CustomField.description: PMGs on this visit. A visit-level field so the PMG dashboard filter limits visits instead of only the joined PMG rows.
CustomField.formula: IF(PMG_Count_Mill__c > 0, "Mill; ", "") & IF(PMG_Count_Screen__c > 0, "Screen; ", "") & IF(PMG_Count_Conveyor__c > 0, "Conveyor Component; ", "") & IF(PMG_Count_Hydrocyclone__c > 0, "Hydrocyclone; ", "") & IF(PMG_Count_Trommel__c > 0, "Trommel; ", "") & IF(PMG_Count_Wear__c > 0, "Wear Component; ", "")
CustomField.label: PMG List
